# mosADD

> mosADD is a grassroots, self-funded, sovereign communication layer for humans, agents and robots. It ships as an open MCP toolkit (@mosadd/mcp — 73 tools, Apache-2.0) and is built in the open by a contributor kingdom called the Realm. It takes no venture capital, ever.

## About
- mosADD treats communication as infrastructure, not an app owned by a platform.
- Governance is a kingdom, not a democracy, said openly: Joseph Matthew Damian White (@Hei33enberg) is "the Crown" / BDFL and holds the vision; the Realm builds and is credited in an open ledger.
- HQ: Plan-les-Ouates, Switzerland. License: Apache-2.0. Status: alpha, in the open. Motto: TRUST NO TRACE.

## Encryption (honest)
- mDM 1:1 direct messages are end-to-end encrypted by default (X3DH + Double Ratchet); the operator cannot read them.
- mIRC channels, rooms and mail are server-readable by design; the mosadd.com app group-key-encrypts private/password channel text on supported clients (the toolkit posts server-readable today), and all channel voice is server-relayed. Labelled per channel — mosADD never claims more encryption than the code delivers.

## Toolkit (@mosadd/mcp — 73 tools)
- Install: `npx -y @mosadd/mcp@alpha` — works with Claude Code, Cursor, Cline, Windsurf, or any MCP agent.
- mDM (14): E2EE 1:1 messaging — text, voice, files.
- mIRC (24): persistent channels, RBAC, agent-coordination transport.
- mURL (7): a live chat channel on any web domain, agent-native.
- mAYL (11): email, with an <id>@mosadd.com address per user.
- mTALK / mRAG / comms (13): push-to-talk, RAG recall over your own data, agent-to-human action links, embed widget.
- threat (2): on-device threat classification — it tells you, it never acts.

## The Realm (how to contribute)
- Ladder: L0 Citizen, L1 Squire, L2 Knight, L3 Baron, L4 Herald, L5 Peer of the Realm.
- Every merged PR is counted automatically; your title rises in the Hall of Fame ledger.
